no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: OWPC is not a clinical-stage biotech. Per the FY2024 10-K, the company's Colombian subsidiary OWP SAS entered judicial liquidation effective Oct 1, 2024; current operations consist of (a) selling a CBD-derived consumer product called Pro-11 in the US under the 2018 Farm Bill, and (b) developing industrial-hemp molded containers for automotive parts packaging. Only 2 full-time employees as of Dec 31, 2024. No drug candidates, no clinical trials.
